name: ardulens
description: ArduPilot flight log viewer, analyzer and parameter explorer

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@ardulens/core && npm run build --workspace=@ardulens/app
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@ardulens/core && npm run test --workspace=@ardulens/app
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=@ardulens/core && npm run test:coverage --workspace=@ardulens/app
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@ardulens/core && npm run lint --workspace=@ardulens/app
